name: Salaried Worker Residence Permit (Third-Country National)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an employment contract compliant with Luxembourg labour law; the start date may be made conditional on obtaining the residence/work authorisation.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Luxembourg employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Employer must first declare the vacant position to ADEM (National Employment Agency); if no suitable candidate is found within 3 weeks, ADEM issues a certificate authorising the hire of a non-EU worker.

outcome.duration_length: first permit up to 1 year, restricted to one profession/sector; renewals up to 3 years with access to any sector/profession after continuous employment

sources.title: Guichet.lu -- Conditions of Residence for Third-Country Salaried Workers in Luxembourg: ADEM labour market test, employment contract, permit restricted to one profession/sector initially, 5-year permit for EU long-term residents of another member state

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Luxembourg). No fixed minimum salary threshold was located in this pass -- unlike Finland's or Bulgaria's fixed-euro-figure work permits, Luxembourg's route gates on the ADEM labour market test and a compliant employment contract rather than a stated salary floor. work_rights modeled 'restricted' since the first permit is explicitly limited to one profession/sector.
